newsitem.title: USA: Ernst & Young revenues up more than 20 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ernst & Young revenues up more than 20 pct in 1996.

text.p: Ernst & Young LLP said its revenues totaled $3.57 billion in the year ended September 30 -- an increase of more than 20 percent over the previous fiscal year.

The firm said it this is the second consecutive year it led the Big Six professional services firms in U.S. revenue growth. In fiscal 1995, the firm's revenues grew 17 percent, which is double the firm's 1994 rate.

Worldwide, Ernst & Young International posted double-digit growth for the second year in a row, the firms said. Revenues rose to $7.8 billion, a 13 percent increase over the $6.9 billion of the previous fiscal year. Total personnel worldwide increased by eight percent, from 66,000 to 71,500.
